Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XLVII OF 2002
STAMP (FIFTH SINDH
AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLVII OF
2002
An Ordinance to further amend the Stamp Act, 1899 in
its application to the Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 23rd November, 2002]
No. S.Legis:1(47)/2002, dated
23-11-2002. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.----(1) This Ordinance may be called the Stamp (Fifth Sindh
Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of Act II of 1899

ORDINANCE XLVII OF 2002

ORDINANCE XLVII OF

An Ordinance to further amend the Stamp Act, 1899 in

[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 23rd November, 2002]
No. S.Legis:1(47)/2002, dated
23-11-2002. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Amendment of Act II of
1899.---In the Stamp Act, 1899, in its application to the Province of
Sindh, in the Schedule, in Article 19, for clause (i), the following shall be
substituted:-
"(i) Where the amount does
not
exceed 0.5 Million. 0.2
per cent (Ad
valorem)
(i-a) Where the amount does not
exceed Rs.1.00 Million. One
thousand rupees
